accuracy.evidence: Curriculum placement quoted from the National Curriculum in England Year 2 multiplication and division statement (recall and use multiplication and division facts for the 2, 5 and 10 multiplication tables, including recognising odd and even numbers). Definitions (even = multiple of 2, splits into 2 equal groups or pairs with none over; odd leaves remainder 1) and the ones-digit test (10 is even so only the ones decide) checked against the NCETM Year 2 primary mastery materials. Zero is even (0 = 2 x 0) and the parity sums odd + odd = even, even + odd = odd, even + even = even were checked; every numeric item was evaluated at the corners of its parameter range.

misconceptions.evidence: Targets the documented slips: judging a 2-digit number by its tens digit (step 3 prediction on 58, the drop feedback that says 'the tens digit does not decide', m5, challenge 'tens'), zero as neither (m7, challenge 'zero'), odd + odd = odd (step 5 prediction, m6, challenge 'oddodd'), counting pairs instead of the leftover (m4, challenge 'none' and 'two'), and an unfair 4 and 3 share of 7 (step 2 refuses it with the exact counts, m8, challenge 'left' and 'more').

lab_distinct.evidence: flagoddn tests parity directly: tapping cubes into pairs until one is left without a partner, a fair-share check that refuses a plate getting 2 more and flags the odd last sweet, a ones-digit sorter, a tens-and-ones builder where every ten is drawn as 5 pairs, and a join that shows two leftover cubes pairing. flagskip hops in 2s on a track, flagbond splits cube trains into number bonds and flagoddev is about odd and even functions for ages 16 to 18; lab_distinct gate passes under 30% against every flagship lab.

lab_teaches.evidence: The child makes the pairs, so for 9 they find the lone cube themselves before saying odd; sharing 7 they meet the refusal 'If Mia gets it, Mia has 4 and Leo has 3. Not fair!' and see why 7 is odd; building 35 with three tens shows the tens all in pairs and only the fifth one cube highlighted; joining 3 and 5 the two highlighted lonely cubes disappear into a full column of pairs. The completion text only confirms.

predictions.evidence: Three predictions, each with a tempting wrong option the lab then disproves: 'Every cube gets a partner' for 9 cubes (the pairing leaves one), 'Odd, because 5 is odd' for 58 (the sorter accepts 58 only as even with the tens-digit explanation), and 'Odd, because odd and odd make odd' for 3 + 5 (the joined column shows 8 with no leftover).

challenge_feedback.evidence: Seven rotating challenge questions with ten distinct feedback messages for wrong answers: tens digit does not decide, too big to tell, 27 ends in 7, zero is even, 9 children leave 1 not 0, 2 left could pair again, odd + odd lonely cubes pair, 4 and 4 is only 8, 5 and 5 needs 10, the even list and the counting list.

readability.evidence: Kid paragraphs use short sentences with socks, sweets and counting in 2s, under the family kid readability limit for ages 6 to 7. Canvas words are short labels (Even, Odd, Join, + ten, Give to Mia) on big tiles and the young layout; the adult text uses the Year 2 statement and the precise terms odd, even, pair, equal groups, multiple of 2 and ones digit.

no_filler.evidence: Filler gate clean. Each kid paragraph adds one idea: pairs, fair sharing, the counting-in-2s pattern, the ones digit. Items each test something different: digit test (p1, p4, m1, m2, m5), pairs as doubling (p2, p3, m4), sharing (p5, m8), next even number (m3), odd + odd (m6), zero (m7) and the odd sequence (m9).

mobile.evidence: Checked 360 px Android light and iPhone 13 dark screenshots of every step at the start, mid-demo and after Show me: cubes in the pairing step are about 50 px with links between partners and a 'no partner' tag; the two plates and sweet row fit side by side; the 37 card is 44 px text above two wide bins; tens rods stay inside the left side with the ones on the right and four 58 px key buttons; the joined column of 7 shows the yellow lonely cube with a red ring.

accessibility.evidence: Every canvas action has a labelled button twin: Make a pair, Even and Odd, Give to Mia and Give to Leo, + ten, - ten, + one, - one and Check, and Join. The canvas aria-label is rewritten after every move with the counts and the reason. walk.cjs axe WCAG 2.1 AA clean in light and dark on desktop and iPhone 13 with no console errors.
